description: This council has been asked for its observations on an application received by Westminster City Council for demolition of the existing building and redevelopment of the site to provide a new building comprising two basement levels (including the retention of one existing basement level and the excavation of one new basement level incorporating a mezzanine, 9.37m total depth), plus subterranean sprinkler tank, ground floor and seven upper floors plus rooftop plant enclosure, for hotel use (Class C1), together with ancillary restaurant, bar and caf‚ uses, public realm improvements, servicing facilities and associated works.
site_name: Jumeirah Lowndes Hotel, 21 Lowndes Street, London, SW1X 9ES
